title: Retry with jitter bounded by cap, deadline, and transient-only retries
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might suspect jitter can exceed the cap or that the deadline uses wall time. Jitter multiplies the already-capped delay by a factor in [0, 1], and the deadline is compared only against the injected monotonic clock.
